rule: Cite with the funding-gap caveat attached, not hidden.
Cite livebench.ai directly: never mirrors (stale-aggregator artifacts documented).
Always pin the score source (tbench.ai vs Artificial Analysis diverge); never a bare number.
Cite the trend, never one point; 20-35% methodology swings are known-magnitude.
Disclose its Anthropic investor/client tie in the footnote; never bare-cite the name (collision with USTC's bench).
Footnote out FrontierMath (COI history) and SWE-bench Verified (kept despite contamination) when citing.
High-vote entries only; say 'human-voted, gameable', never 'verified' or 'independent'.
Exclude anonymous entrants (HappyHorse-class); re-pull the live entrant list at each rebuild.
Directional only: top-2 statistically tied and the rival arena disagrees entirely; never a bare #1.
Disclose the self-reported-score caveat; ByteDance co-authorship disclosed when citing ByteDance-adjacent tools.

text: Primary sources are the citation of record; SEO aggregators (benchlm / llm-stats / localaimaster class) are discovery-only.
Composites beat single benches, but know the components: a rotten ingredient (FrontierMath, SWE-bench Verified in ECI) taints the blend silently.

NAME THE HARNESS on any agent or coding score: on Terminal-Bench the same model scored 58% in one harness and 75 to 82% in others (Theo Browne, t3.gg, "Did Claude really get dumber again?", 2026-04-20, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KFisvc-AMII).
Adoption is not quality: OpenRouter volume is telemetry; AA's #1 ranks #7 by usage.
A vendor's own model leading the vendor's own benchmark is never evidence (Google/FACTS+SimpleQA-Verified, OpenAI/GDPval, MinerU/OmniDocBench, NVIDIA/Open-ASR).
Arenas: high-vote, named entrants only; call them 'human-voted, gameable', never 'independent'.
Stamp every citation 'as of <date>'; frozen boards (Aider Oct 2025, LiveCodeBench Apr 2025, VBench Apr 2026, HAL Jul 2026) are archival, not current.
Never a bare #1: frontier gaps sit inside statistical noise on nearly every board (top-10 within ~20 Elo on Arena; 4 trackers, 4 different MMLU-Pro leaders).
Disclose the named caveat every time a canon benchmark is cited: the caveat IS the trust layer.
Saturated benchmarks demote to floor-gates (Cybench, MMLU-Pro, GPQA): 'passes the floor' is meaningful, ranking is not.

Re-vet cadence: coding quarterly at minimum (the succession pattern: Verified -> Pro -> Deep SWE each re-developed the same failure), everything else semi-annually, any benchmark on a funding/ownership change immediately.
SMB SaaS tools: NO independent capability benchmark exists (Salesforce grades itself; G2 bought Capterra + Software Advice + GetApp Feb 2026: one pay-to-play owner).
Run-to-run reliability: nobody measures consistency across repeated runs: the thing an operator experiences as trustworthy. tau2-bench's pass^k is the lone partial exception.
Human-oversight cost: capability-per-dollar exists; check-its-work time is measured nowhere. Princeton HAL's cost axis was closest and is now frozen.
AI-search accuracy: no credible independent study since Columbia Tow Center (Mar 2025, all-eight-bad). Every circulating percentage is SEO/vendor content.
Voice-cloning fidelity: no neutral benchmark isolates clone similarity; every '#1 at cloning' claim is vendor marketing.
Safety currency: no continuously-updated public safety leaderboard exists the way capability ones do: 'is it safe' is structurally less visible to a buyer than 'is it smart'.
